outcome_detail: Active in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Ohio. The city and Chief Merkel formally denied liability in a May 16, 2025 filing; the case was paused pending Edwards' criminal appeals and the stay was lifted after the Ohio 11th District Court of Appeals upheld his convictions, with a court schedule running into mid-2026 (March 2026 discovery deadline reported). No settlement or judgment reported as of July 2026.
criminal_detail: Michael Edwards Jr. was convicted in September 2024 in Trumbull County on charges including rape, sexual battery, gross sexual imposition, extortion and theft in office involving six victims, and was sentenced to an indefinite prison term of 34 to 39 years. The 11th District Court of Appeals upheld the convictions and sentence (April 2026) and the Ohio Supreme Court declined to hear his appeal. He is incarcerated at the Toledo Correctional Institution.
description: Three women filed a federal civil rights lawsuit in March 2025 in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Ohio against former Warren police officer Michael Edwards Jr., the City of Warren, and Police Chief Eric J. Merkel. The suit alleges that Edwards raped, sexually battered and extorted multiple women between 2019 and 2024 while on duty, using threats of arrest to coerce sexual acts and targeting vulnerable residents. According to the complaint, a 2019 harassment complaint against Edwards was ignored and the city failed to act on warnings about his conduct. Edwards was convicted in September 2024 of rape, sexual battery and related charges involving six victims and is serving a 34-to-39-year prison sentence. The city and chief have denied liability, and the civil case remains active.
notes: Companion records: rec-33b (fourth woman's suit, filed July 2025) and rec-33c ($1 million suit against the city and chief, filed February 2026) arise from the same scandal but are distinct filings.
